paragraphs: Citibot sells an AI communications platform built for government. It answers resident questions instantly and works to keep the underlying information accurate and accessible. The product combines voice, text and web automation in one system.

The assistant runs in a closed environment, retrieving verified information only from content the agency has approved. It answers in more than 75 languages and is available around the clock. The company says the platform is meant to sit alongside the software an agency already runs.

Citibot works with local governments from small towns to large cities. The customer page puts the count at more than 200 governments. Much of the use sits with 311 centers and call-heavy departments, where residents can get answers and submit requests without picking up the phone. The company describes over a decade of work behind the platform.

quote.text: For 311 centers and call-heavy departments, Citibot helps residents get answers, submit requests, and connect with the right resources without always needing to pick up the phone.
